# Code of Conduct

This project follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short:

- Treat everyone with respect. Assume good faith.
- Keep discussions focused on the work — code, issues, design, docs.
- Disagree on technical merit, not on people.
- Harassment of any kind is not welcome, here or in any project space (issues,
  pull requests, code comments, commits).

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all project spaces — the repository, issues,
pull requests, discussions, and any other communication channel tied to the
project. It also applies when an individual is officially representing the
project in public spaces.

## Enforcement

Concerns or reports may be sent privately to **josluna1098@gmail.com**.

Reports will be reviewed and handled by the maintainer. The maintainer will
respect the privacy of the reporter and act in good faith to address the
issue.

The full Contributor Covenant text — including detailed examples and the
enforcement ladder — is the authoritative reference linked at the top of this
document.
